state: A5000 native bridge adopted at e2212c40566e21c680a98186ebd8e984aa80d4fd; four allocated GPU workers launched; source/transport hashes separate
purpose: Automatically launch without another user message; producer may publish this small interface in READY alongside its own implementations. No scientific source is defined by receiver.

required_ready_keys.files: list of {path,sha256}, covering all scripts/qf_overnight and configs/qf_overnight executable/config files

execution_interface.launch_handles_transactional_queue_worke: shared producer runner, not old queue_cli
execution_interface.status_output: {run_root}/queue_status.json with counts, all_terminal, all_required_validated and worker PID/checkpoint/heartbeat evidence
execution_interface.publication_output: {run_root}/publication_manifest.json with files:[{path,sha256}] relative to run_root; immutable success outputs only; no live SQLite/checkpoints
execution_interface.control: pause command stops new claims, allows active jobs to finish; stop --active is separate explicit user control
execution_interface.run_metadata: exact source/protocol/input/split/config/transform hashes; per-job validation must gate success
execution_interface.environment: QF_OWNER,QF_RUN_GROUP,QF_INPUT_ROOT,QF_DATA_ROOT,QF_RUN_ROOT,QF_CONTROL_PATH,QF_CPU_THREADS=2,QF_DATALOADER_WORKERS=0; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES scoped to free allocated UUIDs

required_identity: selected=true for frozen validation-selected fits only
aggregation_contract_request.daily_and_metric_files: metrics.csv beside daily_loss_sums.csv; can be in run output subdirectories; selected=true; all selected seeds retained. Other metric columns are carried into consolidated table.
aggregation_contract_request.key_digest: Sort asset_id,date,origin_time; TAB-separated asset_id,date,origin_time,endpoint_time,split,legacy_label; UTF8 LF, no header. Date is ISO. Fold is a separate identity field; split is the fold-specific split.
aggregation_contract_request.missing_export_policy: Publish exact partial/missing status; no inner joins or best-score selection. Receiver refetches snapshots every5min and regenerates matched tables automatically.
aggregation_contract_request.bootstrap: 10000 draws, 5-date noncircular blocks, seed20261001; all3 matched seeds; pooled row weights; rolling blocks cannot cross folds.

deadline: 12 hours after receiver starts; no performance improvement gate
notes: UM factor exclusion remains a producer obligation; it must not block unrelated UA/UC/SQ jobs on this receiver.
